note: [1] GBD 2023 publishes Ischemic heart disease INCIDENCE as acute myocardial infarction (MI) incidence only — it counts new heart-attack events, not new diagnoses of coronary disease. IHD's other components are not part of this incidence figure: stable coronary artery disease is modelled as prevalence (GBD publishes no stable-CAD incidence), and heart failure due to IHD is estimated in the impairment/heart-failure pipeline rather than folded into cause-level IHD incidence. Prevalence and the other measures are unaffected. Source: GBD 2023 Nonfatal methods appendix, Ischaemic heart disease — Case definition, pp.745-746; retrieve it with search_methods(doc='epi_nonfatal2023', entity='Ischemic heart disease').
